_comment: Copy this file to C:\Users\<你>\.agents\ego-profile.json (macOS/Linux: ~/.agents/ego-profile.json) and fill in YOUR machine's values. This file is machine-local: never commit it, never put real emails into the repo. defaultProfileId comes from running `profiles()` in ego-browser nodejs (ego-profile-check.mjs MODE=list prints it). defaultAccount is the email that must be logged in on that profile — dispatch templates verify it before sending (1 call to /api/auth/session).
